summary: More than most people, a fast, restless mind and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you reach, grow, and lift the room. It rewards you when you reach for it.
body: More than most people, a fast, restless mind and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something work together when you choose to use them. The opening is there: you think and talk your way through anything, you reach, grow, and lift the room. It rewards you when you reach for it. Strong for pairing vision with persuasion; watch overstatement.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel — or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let thinking and speech and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for pairing vision with persuasion; watch overstatement.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
